plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction with 3 bidders: winner pays the second-highest bid. The dominant strategy is to bid my true private value. Bidding $48 maximizes my expected surplus: I win whenever opponents' bids are below 48 and pay the highest of theirs, yielding value minus price. No benefit to shading in a single independent-draw round.]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction: your bid determines whether you win, but you pay the second-highest bid. Truthful bidding (bid your private value) is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit regardless of others. No prior rounds/histories to learn from here. Tie-breaking is random; bid my value $38. ]

[In a second-price auction with three bidders, bidding your true private value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' actions. Bidding above $12 can produce negative surplus if you win and pay more than your value; bidding below $12 can forgo positive-profit wins. There is no past-history information to exploit and values are independent each round, so submit a bid equal to my value: $12.]
